clips.title: The story
paras: A Friend of the Family is an urgent courier task originating from Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Fearing local threats like the Dragonmaw orcs, the harbor authorities entrust an adventurer to deliver the priceless Menethil Statuette directly to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

Menethil Harbor serves as a crucial naval gateway linking the northern reaches of the Eastern Kingdoms to the south. Named in honor of the late King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron, the port stands isolated among treacherous marshes and aggressive enemies. With local threats mounting, harbor leadership recognizes that priceless relics associated with the fallen northern kingdom cannot remain safely in such an exposed outpost.

The Wetlands remain infested with remnants of the Dragonmaw clan, savage orcs known for their dark past and ruthless opportunism. Given their proximity and hunger for conquest, harbor defenders fear the Dragonmaw would stop at nothing to pillage historical treasures like the Menethil Statuette, possibly defiling or weaponizing such a symbol for their own ends.

Rather than risk delays through standard bureaucratic or military channels, the courier is instructed to bypass the chain of command entirely. The relic is dispatched directly to Stormwind Keep into the hands of Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, regent of the young King Anduin Wrynn, trusting that the leadership in the capital can best safeguard a piece of Lordaeron's heritage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.
The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... And I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.
Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, friend. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
